source.citation: HYG Database v4.4, David Nash / Astronexus (https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Compiled from the Hipparcos catalogue (ESA 1997; new reduction van Leeuwen 2007), the Yale Bright Star Catalogue (5th ed.) and the Gliese Catalogue of Nearby Stars (3rd ed.). Star names: IAU Catalog of Star Names (IAU-CSN), IAU Division C Working Group on Star Names (WGSN), https://exopla.net/star-names/modern-iau-star-names/ (linked from iau.org).

selection: All HYG stars except the Sun having a proper name, a Bayer and/or Flamsteed designation, a Gliese/GJ number, or apparent V magnitude < 6.5. Rows sorted by apparent magnitude (brightest first). Stars without a usable distance are included with index/absMag/distPc/luminositySolar = null.

units.luminositySolar: L_sun in the V band, HYG value 10^(0.4 (4.85 - M_V)); not bolometric

nullPolicy: null = not available in the source (never 0).

nameCrossCheck.rule: properName = IAU WGSN name when the star is matched (HIP, then HR, HD, GJ, then position <= 30"); otherwise the HYG proper name. properNameSource says which.
